method: Only in-memory common decision/stay/route horizon changes from 3.6 to 7 seconds. Three route stages, rack/yaw/lateral dynamics, 0.08-second dwell, headway, safePath first-step and emergency geometry, input controls, gas and all production physics/collisions/NPC AI are unchanged. Six new horizon variants; 20-car current baselines reused, three 36-car baselines run locally.
conclusion: Do not adopt the uniform 7-second, three-stage horizon-only variant. It does not produce a stable improvement across the six paired cases: mean run medians decrease at both densities and total overtakes decrease, despite no observed collisions or jumps. Keep the current production candidate and disclose residual low-speed following; these results do not prove every remaining slow period unavoidable.
